## Dynamic but strong

Variables are names bound to objects; types live on the object, not the name. Python won't silently coerce `"1" + 1`.

## Numbers

`int` has arbitrary precision (no overflow). `float` is IEEE-754. Use `//` for floor division, `%` for remainder, `**` for power.

## Truthiness

Empty containers, `0`, `""`, and `None` are falsy; most other values are truthy.

big = 2 ** 100          # arbitrary precision
q, r = divmod(17, 5)     # (3, 2)
